'''Summoned Zombie''' is a monster that is spawned by the [[Ulthven necromancer]]s in [[The Shadow Reef]].

In story mode, their life points is 6,000, down from 12,000.

*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Elite Dungeons - Shadow Reef|date=25 February 2019}}
